# Null calibration (generated by `studies/null_calibration.py`)

Synthetic panels: 10 assets, 1800 days, 200 null seeds, 50 seeds per signal strength. Nominal test level 5% (|t| > 1.96). Brackets: 95% CI.

## False-positive rate on data with no signal

| Protocol | Rejects H0 |
|---|---|
| corrected_rank_ic_newey_west | 5.5% [2.8–9.6] |
| same_ic_naive_t_ignoring_overlap | 32.0% [25.6–38.9] |
| legacy_C7_fold_pearson_t | 22.5% [16.9–28.9] |
| legacy_C6_fold_pearson_t | 12.0% [7.8–17.3] |
| best_of_12_configs_t_nw | 30.0% [23.7–36.9] |
| best_of_12_configs_dsr_above_0.95 | 1.5% [0.3–4.3] |
